name: roast-my-design-system-skill
description: The skill edition of roast-my-design-system: one skill that runs the published scanner from npm. A 0-100 design-system score, the receipts, the first fixes, and a shareable HTML report. No hooks, no local server, no scripts inside the plugin.

plugins.name: roast-my-design-system
plugins.description: Roast your repo's design system with real data: a 0-100 health score, the receipts, and the first fixes ranked by payoff. Runs the published scanner from npm; deterministic, read-only, benchmarked against 119 public repos and 10 reputable design systems, one shareable light/dark HTML report.
